scope: The W-action on the 5-torsion of the E6 torus. Establishes homogeneity of the rows and therefore UNIQUENESS of the invariant measure ON EACH ROW -- but only for the group W x Galois. Under W alone the invariant measures on a split row form a multi-parameter family. Says NOTHING about the manifold, and nothing about whether the Z/5 menu is this object's -- B8086 showed it is NOT (H_1 = Z, torsion-free). Gate 5 untouched.
verdict: homogeneous, but ARITHMETICALLY: one W x Galois orbit per row, while W alone gives 25 orbits and splits 8 of the 9 rows
